title: JWT secret rotation not enforced
exploit_path: If JWT secret is leaked, all tokens become permanently valid until secret changed
remediation: Implement automatic JWT secret rotation with grace period

title: Private key storage in environment variables
exploit_path: Environment variables may be logged or exposed in process dumps
remediation: Use hardware security module (HSM) or secret manager (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager)

title: Analytics reads all sensitive data without field-level masking
exploit_path: Analytics dashboard may expose PII/health data to users with analytics role
remediation: Implement field-level masking in analytics queries based on user role

title: Medical images stored without encryption-at-rest check
exploit_path: If S3/MinIO bucket is misconfigured, medical images may be publicly accessible
remediation: Enforce server-side encryption (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS) and validate bucket policies

title: Government API errors may leak sensitive data in logs
exploit_path: SEFAZ error responses containing CNPJ/tax data may be logged without masking
remediation: Mask CNPJ/CPF in logs; use structured logging with PII redaction

title: No file size limit on radiograph uploads
exploit_path: Large file uploads could cause DoS or storage exhaustion
remediation: Add file size limits and scan uploads for malware
